strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: The Rust runtime advances a headless continuation across the post-apply verification retry admission boundary.
Successful proposal.apply evidence remains the only workspace mutation input and is revalidated before retry admission.
The admitted retry task is routed to explicit task.run verifier execution instead of running verifiers automatically.
Headless decision and retry task admission evidence are bounded runtime state without raw workspace/provider/process data.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting controlled_workspace_tools, controlled_verification_execution, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can create or replay one verification recovery retry task after successful recovery proposal.apply evidence.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Existing task.start retry admission works only when a caller manually assembles the post-apply retry envelope; existing headless continuation stops at route guidance.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless callers remain stuck at the apply-to-verify boundary and must own fragile routing outside the Rust runtime.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M14.2 handled transaction recovery mutation, M15.1 handled WriteWorkspace apply permission, and M15.2 handled AccessNetwork provider permission; this phase changes headless post-apply retry admission.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.continue_once method is extended.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. Returned next-route evidence is tied to actual retry task admission and existing bounded task handles.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: A current authorized headless continuation mutates runtime task state by admitting or replaying one verification recovery retry task.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Moves Brownie toward a replay-safe apply -> verify -> recover -> complete loop without caller-owned routing logic.
answers.milestone_progress: Establishes the first M16 vertical slice and prepares later explicit retry execution through headless continuation.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M16.1 updates the deterministic current phase manifest. Review must confirm runtime retry task admission behavior, not a headless route wrapper.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts bounded verification_recovery_retry_source evidence with explicit retry authorization
current aggregate progress fingerprint and sequence are checked before retry task creation
valid source/recovery/proposal/apply evidence creates or replays exactly one verification recovery retry task
replayed continuation_id returns the same retry task handles without duplicate TaskStarted or TaskRunning evidence
stale progress or stale source/apply fingerprints fail before task creation
response routes to run_verification_retry_task_explicitly and does not execute the retry task
no proposal.apply, workspace mutation, verifier execution, provider execution, shell, git, network, service, scheduler, or VSIX policy decision is added
bounded evidence excludes raw prompts, provider responses, file content, diffs, commands, stdout/stderr, environment values, secrets, absolute paths, and canonical paths
next_phase_candidate_notes: After M16.1 merge, consider a bounded M16.2 phase that lets headless.continue_once run one already-admitted verification retry task explicitly, without automatic apply or scheduler behavior.
